以开普勒椭圆和数据表周期观察八大行星；轨道间距经过压缩。: Explore Keplerian ellipses and tabulated periods; spacing between orbits is compressed.
太阳与八大行星按同一个直径尺度排列，用正交投影比较大小。: The Sun and eight planets share one diameter scale, with orthographic projection for size comparisons.
聚焦水星、金星、地球和火星。: Focus on Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars.
聚焦木星、土星、天王星和海王星。: Focus on Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.
太阳的引力主导行星的绕日运动。点击行星名称，跟着它观察。: The Sun's gravity governs the planets' orbits. Select a planet's name to follow it.
画面压缩了轨道间距，也放大了天体。: Orbit spacing is compressed and the bodies are enlarged.
水星绕太阳一周约 88 天，地球约一年，海王星约 165 年。: Mercury takes about 88 days to orbit the Sun, Earth about a year, and Neptune about 165 years.
播放后比较它们转过的角度。: Press play and compare how far around each orbit they travel.
时间轴一轮表示 12 个模拟年，不是一颗行星的一年。: One timeline cycle represents 12 simulated years, not one year of any particular planet.
行星沿椭圆绕太阳运动。靠近太阳时较快，远离太阳时较慢。: Planets follow ellipses, moving faster near the Sun and slower farther away.
每条轨道分别缩放，椭圆形状保留，轨道之间的距离比例不保留。: Each orbit is scaled separately. Elliptical shapes are preserved, but distance ratios between orbits are not.
土星环由许多小颗粒构成。倾斜视角能帮助我们看到环的形状。: Saturn's rings contain countless small particles. An angled view helps reveal their shape.
选择土星，然后拖动画面。: Select Saturn, then drag the scene.
本图的环是示意模型，不模拟每一粒物质的运动。: These rings are an illustration; individual particles are not simulated.
模型能告诉我们什么？: What can this model tell us?
这里可以比较周期、轨道形状和天体大小。真实太阳系还有行星之间的相互影响。: Compare periods, orbital shapes and sizes here. In the real solar system, planets also affect one another.
切到排排队，比较大小。: Switch to the lineup to compare sizes.
初始位置是示意，不对应今天的行星位置。: Starting positions are illustrative, not the planets' positions today.
把太阳和行星放到一起: Bring the Sun and planets together
所有球体都用同一个直径尺度，间隔只为方便观察。: All spheres share one diameter scale. Gaps are arranged for readability.
正交相机让远近不会改变画面中的大小比例。: An orthographic camera keeps apparent size ratios independent of distance.
地球与金星大小接近，水星和火星更小。: Earth and Venus are similar in size; Mercury and Mars are smaller.
用“只看行星”找到四颗岩石行星。: Use “Planets only” to find the four rocky planets.
比较的是球体直径，光环不计入天体直径。: We compare spherical diameters; rings are not part of a planet's diameter.
木星比地球大很多: Jupiter is much bigger than Earth
木星直径约是地球的 11 倍。直径比较与体积比较是两件事。: Jupiter's diameter is about 11 times Earth's. Comparing diameters is different from comparing volumes.
比较木星和地球的高度。: Compare the heights of Jupiter and Earth.
球体体积随直径的三次方变化。: A sphere's volume scales with the cube of its diameter.
木星、土星、天王星和海王星都比地球大。: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune are all bigger than Earth.
比较土星球体与它的环。: Compare Saturn's globe with its rings.
木星与土星是气态巨行星，天王星与海王星是冰巨行星；它们并不是实心冰球。: Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants; Uranus and Neptune are ice giants, not solid balls of ice.
切回“全部天体”，太阳也完整显示在同一尺度中。地球会显得很小。: Switch back to “All bodies” to see the whole Sun at the same scale. Earth will look tiny.
找找太阳旁边的行星队伍。: Find the line of planets beside the Sun.
太阳直径约是地球的 109 倍。放大观察不会改变球体之间的比例。: The Sun's diameter is about 109 times Earth's. Zooming preserves the ratios between the spheres.
水星、金星、地球与火星是四颗类地行星。: Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars are the four terrestrial planets.
依次点击四颗行星。: Select each of the four planets.
画面聚焦内侧，其他行星仍按各自周期运行。: This view focuses on the inner system; the other planets keep following their own periods.
水星绕太阳跑一圈约需 88 天。: Mercury takes about 88 days to circle the Sun.
看它何时再次回到起点附近。: Watch for it to return near its starting position.
公转与自转是两种不同运动。: Orbiting and spinning are different motions.
金星的自转很慢，方向也与地球不同。: Venus rotates slowly, in a different direction from Earth.
打开行星卡片比较自转周期。: Open the planet cards to compare rotation periods.
学术版显示自转周期，并单独标明逆向。: The Science view shows rotation periods and marks retrograde rotation separately.
地球的旁边还有月球绕行。: The Moon also orbits beside Earth.
月球距离、大小和动画速度为示意，不用于测量。: The Moon's distance, size and animation speed are illustrative, not for measurement.
火星比地球离太阳更远，公转一周也更久。: Mars is farther from the Sun than Earth and takes longer to orbit it.
比较卡片中的公转周期。: Compare the orbital periods on the cards.
需要看大小时，请切换到排排队。: Switch to the lineup when comparing sizes.
外太阳系的巨行星: Giants of the outer solar system
木星、土星、天王星与海王星都在地球轨道之外。: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune all orbit beyond Earth.
依次选择四颗巨行星。: Select each of the four giants.
外侧轨道间距被压缩，不能用屏幕距离测量天文单位。: Outer orbit spacing is compressed; screen distances cannot measure astronomical units.
木星的一年约十二年: A year on Jupiter is about twelve Earth years
时间轴的一轮接近木星的一次公转。: One timeline cycle is close to one orbit of Jupiter.
比较起点和终点。: Compare its starting and finishing positions.
模型采用数据表中的周期，不把木星周期强制设成十二年。: The model uses the tabulated period, not an imposed twelve-year orbit.
从侧面看光环: Look at the rings from the side
土星环随着球体的倾斜呈现不同形状。: Saturn's tilted rings look different from different angles.
聚焦土星并拖动视角。: Focus on Saturn and drag to change the view.
相机改变的是观察角度，不是行星物理倾角。: The camera changes your viewing angle, not the planet's physical tilt.
它的自转轴接近躺在轨道平面上。: Its rotation axis lies almost in the plane of its orbit.
查看学术版卡片中的倾角。: Check its axial tilt in the Science view card.
极大的倾角也影响自转方向的描述。: Such a large tilt also affects how we describe its rotation direction.
海王星需要很久才能绕一圈: Neptune takes a long time to orbit
十二个模拟年内，海王星只走过轨道的一小部分。: In twelve simulated years, Neptune covers only a small part of its orbit.
播放并观察它的位置变化。: Press play and watch its position change.
示意相位不用于预测真实日期的行星位置。: Illustrative phases cannot predict positions on real dates.
平均近点角随时间均匀增加，初始相位为示意。: Mean anomaly increases uniformly with time; the starting phase is illustrative.
数值求解开普勒方程；真近点角不按匀角速度推进。: Kepler's equation is solved numerically; true anomaly does not advance at constant angular speed.
先在轨道平面计算以太阳为焦点的椭圆，再施加轨道倾角。: An ellipse with the Sun at a focus is calculated in the orbital plane, then tilted.
同一条轨道满足等面积定律；各轨道分别缩放。: Each orbit satisfies the equal-area law and is scaled separately.
读数由所选行星的数据计算。表中数值经过舍入；不包含多体摄动。: Readings use the selected planet's data. Tabulated values are rounded; multi-body perturbations are excluded.
屏幕直径比 = 数据直径比: Screen diameter ratio = data diameter ratio
同尺度球体配合正交投影；间隔为排版安排。: Equal-scale spheres use orthographic projection; gaps are a layout choice.
统一以数据表直径计算，不混用近似比例。: All ratios use tabulated diameters rather than mixed approximations.
球体近似下，体积比是直径比的三次方。: For spheres, the volume ratio is the cube of the diameter ratio.
光环不计入直径；比较模式补光以便辨认轮廓。: Rings are excluded; fill lighting makes silhouettes easier to see.
太阳与八大行星采用同一个长度缩放系数。: The Sun and all eight planets use one length scale factor.
太阳是太阳系里唯一的发光大火球！它占了整个太阳系 99.86% 的总重量，肚子里: The Sun is our solar system's shining star! It holds 99.86% of the system's mass and has room for about 1.3 million Earths by volume.
太阳系绝对的引力主导中心。通过核心热核聚变（质子-质子链反应）辐射能量，提供行星: The dominant gravitational body in the solar system. Core nuclear fusion, mainly the proton–proton chain, supplies its radiated energy; its gravity governs planetary orbits.
溜冰冠军水星！它是离太阳最近的小朋友，跑得最快（88天就过完一年），但因为没有大: Speedy Mercury is closest to the Sun and finishes a year in 88 days! With almost no atmosphere to trap heat, its days can exceed 400°C and its nights drop far below freezing.
水星处于强引力场中，爱因斯坦广义相对论的经典实验验证之一便是解释其每百年 43: Mercury's orbit provided a classic test of general relativity: the extra perihelion precession is about 43 arcseconds per century. It has no dense atmosphere.
倒着转的明亮金星！天空中除了太阳和月亮最亮的就是它。它裹着厚厚的黄色浓硫酸云被子: Bright Venus spins backward! Only the Sun and Moon are brighter in our sky. Beneath thick sulfuric-acid clouds, it turns slowly, with the Sun rising in the west.
失控温室效应的极端典型。厚达数十公里的二氧化碳与硫酸云层导致地表气压高达 92: An extreme greenhouse world. Its dense carbon-dioxide atmosphere and sulfuric-acid clouds accompany a surface pressure about 92 times Earth's and a mean surface temperature around 465°C.
我们最温暖美丽的蓝色家园！拥有清澈的大海、绿色森林、氧气和可爱的月亮伙伴，是太阳: Our beautiful blue home has oceans, forests, air to breathe and a Moon! It is the only world in the solar system known to host life.
处于太阳系宜居带（Goldilocks Zone）正中。具有稳定的氮氧大气层、全: Earth lies in the Sun's habitable zone. Its nitrogen–oxygen atmosphere, global magnetic field, plate tectonics and abundant liquid water help sustain complex carbon-based life.
红彤彤的沙漠侦探星！土壤里富含生锈的氧化铁，两极顶着白雪般的水冰与干冰帽。人类派: Rusty red Mars is a desert world! Iron oxides color its soil, and water ice and dry ice form its polar caps. Many rovers have explored its surface.
拥有全太阳系最高的火山（奥林匹斯山，高约 21 km）和最长峡谷（水手号峡谷）。: Home to Olympus Mons, about 21 km high, and the vast Valles Marineris canyon system. Despite its thin atmosphere, Mars preserves evidence of ancient rivers and deltas.
太阳系的巨无霸大队长！它个头大到能装进 1300 多个地球！肚子上还有个吹了30: Jupiter is the giant of the planets! Its volume could hold over 1,300 Earths, and the Great Red Spot is an enormous, long-lived storm.
质量是太阳系其他所有行星总质量的 2.5 倍。成分以氢、氦为主，巨大的自转速度驱: Its mass is about 2.5 times that of the other planets combined. Mostly hydrogen and helium, its rapid rotation helps shape atmospheric bands and the Great Red Spot, an anticyclonic storm.
戴着全宇宙最漂亮金光草帽的明星！壮丽的光环其实是由无数亮晶晶的碎冰块和小岩石排着: Saturn wears spectacular bright rings! Countless pieces of ice and rock make them shimmer in sunlight.
平均密度仅约 0.69 g/cm³（唯一低于水密度的行星）。光环处于洛希极限之内: Its mean density is about 0.69 g/cm³, the only planet below water's density. Tidal forces within the Roche limit inhibit ring debris from gathering into one moon.
调皮的“躺平打滚星”！别的星球都是像陀螺一样立着转，天王星却躺得平平的（倾斜98: Uranus spins on its side! Its axis is tilted by about 98°, very different from Earth's upright-looking spin.
富含水、氨、甲烷冰质物质的冰巨星。其异常极端的近 98° 自转轴倾角，被普遍认为: An ice giant rich in water-, ammonia- and methane-bearing material. A giant impact early in its history is one proposed explanation for its roughly 98° axial tilt.
守在太阳系大门最远处的蔚蓝大巨人！阳光要走4个多小时才能跑到它那里。上面刮着全太: Distant blue Neptune guards the outer planetary realm! Sunlight takes more than four hours to reach it, and powerful winds race through its atmosphere.
绕日一周需地球时间近 165 年。甲烷强烈吸收红光赋予其深邃宝石蓝外观，内部热源: One orbit takes nearly 165 Earth years. Methane absorbs red light, contributing to its blue appearance; the planet also has internal heat and winds exceeding 2,100 km/h.

怎样阅读这两个模型？: How to read these two models
公转图按数据表中的偏心率与周期求解开普勒方程，表现椭圆轨道和快慢变化。每条轨道单: The orbit view solves Kepler's equation using tabulated eccentricities and periods, showing elliptical paths and changing speeds. Each orbit is scaled separately, and bodies are enlarged, so screen distances and body sizes are not directly comparable.
排排队将太阳与八大行星按同一个直径尺度绘制，并使用正交相机避免远近造成大小变化。: The lineup draws the Sun and eight planets at one diameter scale. An orthographic camera prevents perspective from changing apparent size. Gaps serve the layout; fill lighting makes outlines visible.
初始相位和轨道朝向为示意，不对应真实日期。模型不含多体摄动，月球和小行星带仅供辨: Starting phases and orbital orientations are illustrative, not tied to real dates. Multi-body perturbations are excluded; the Moon and asteroid belt are landmarks only. One timeline cycle represents twelve simulated years. The Science view computes a³/T² from the selected planet's data in AU³/yr².
